name: CSV Cleanup
description: Clean a messy spreadsheet or CSV into a new file: tidy headers, standard dates and numbers, no blank or duplicate rows.
abilities: Tidies headers and trims stray spaces
Standardises dates and numbers, column by column
Drops blank and duplicate rows into a new file, never the original
Reports every change and every value it couldn't read
permissions: Uses the Code plugin: runs in your private, offline sandbox
